entries.en: Yadovv Gah means to use the nature of the Amalj'aa's blessings against them.
entries.fr: Yadovv Gah cherche un moyen d'affaiblir l'aura protectrice d'Ifrit.
entries.ja: 灰の陣営のヤドヴ・ガーは、蛮神の加護を弱めたいようだ。
entries.section: Allied Society Quests (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)

entries.en: Yadovv Gah suspects that the voracious flames of Ifrit's blessings will feed upon each other, and has enlisted your aid to test his theory in practice. Pass through the gates of Zahar'ak, and first hunt down fortune-tellers for their wildfire idols.
entries.fr: Yadovv Gah a pour projet de détruire des <frnoun(EventItem,12,2001123,2,1)> en les jetant dans <frnoun(EObj,1,2002918,1,1)>. Procurez-vous deux <frnoun(EventItem,12,2001123,2,1)> en combattant des <frnoun(BNpcName,12,2303,2,1)>.
entries.ja: ヤドヴ・ガーの依頼を受けた。ザハラク戦陣にいる「<sheet(BNpcName,2303,0)>」を討伐し、「<sheet(EventItem,2001123,0)>」を2個入手しよう。

entries.section: Allied Society Quests (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)

entries.en: You have slain fortune-tellers and obtained a pair of wildfire idols. Find the Inferno altar in the north of Zahar'ak, and cast the idols into its flames.
entries.fr: Vous avez obtenu les deux <frnoun(EventItem,12,2001123,2,1)>. Utilisez-les sur <frnoun(EObj,2,2002918,1,1)> au nord de Zahar'ak.
entries.ja: <sheet(BNpcName,2303,0)>を討伐し、<sheet(EventItem,2001123,0)>を入手した。ザハラク戦陣の北にある「<sheet(EObj,2002918,0)>」に「<sheet(EventItem,2001123,0)>」を使おう。

entries.section: Allied Society Quests (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)

entries.en: You consign the wildfire idols to the fires of the Inferno altar, and the resulting conflagration reduces everything in the vicinity to slag and charcoal. Return to the Ring of Ash and report to Yadovv Gah.
entries.fr: Vous avez utilisé les <frnoun(EventItem,12,2001123,2,1)> sur <frnoun(EObj,2,2002918,1,1)>. Retournez à présent faire votre rapport à Yadovv Gah.
entries.ja: <sheet(EObj,2002918,0)>に<sheet(EventItem,2001123,0)>を使った。灰の陣営の「ヤドヴ・ガー」に報告しよう。

entries.en: Yadovv Gah seems both elated and relieved at the success of his plan. With such tactics proven to be effective, it is only a matter of time before the fragile strength of the Zahar'ak Amalj'aa is shattered completely.
entries.fr: Yadovv Gah se réjouit du succès de son plan. Il compte sur votre aide pour d'éventuelles futures missions.
entries.ja: ヤドヴ・ガーに報告した。作戦が上手くいって、ヤドヴ・ガーも一安心のようだ。敵アマルジャ族の占星術師に目にものを見せてやれたと、彼は喜んでいた。またの機会に協力しよう。
entries.section: Allied Society Quests (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)

entries.en: Slay Zahar'ak fortune-tellers and obtain wildfire idols.
entries.section: Allied Society Quests (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)

entries.en: Cast wildfire idols into the Inferno altar.
entries.section: Allied Society Quests (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)

entries.fr: Faire un rapport à Yadovv Gah
entries.section: Allied Society Quests (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)

entries.en: Have you met with the fortune-tellers of Zahar'ak in battle, honored ally? Each of these mystics carries a ritual tool known as a wildfire idol.
entries.fr: Des objets appelés “<frnoun(EventItem,12,2001123,2,1)>” il y a au cœur de Zahar'ak. Ces fétiches, les devins utilisent pour leurs cérémonies.
entries.ja:
ザハラク戦陣の占星術師の愛用する祭器に、
「」と呼ばれる物があり申す。

entries.en: It is an iron statuette forged in the sacred flames of Ifrit, and possessed of a potent aura that invigorates any of the faithful that draw near. Though we have seized several of these idols before, their god-tempered nature rendered them irritatingly difficult to destroy.
entries.fr: Animés d'une aura mystérieuse, ces objets sont. En acier renforcé par le feu divin, ils ont été fabriqués. Très forte, leur puissance protectrice est. Quasi indestructibles, cela les rend.
entries.ja:
これは聖火で焼き鍛えた鉄製の偶像で、
強大な焔神の加護の効果をもつ物品。
しかも魔力により、易々とは傷つかぬ代物であり申す。

entries.en: But if we are to deny our hated enemy every advantage, then destroy them we must! I have thought long on this matter, and the mindless, raging nature of Ifrit's blessings might be made to work in our favor.
entries.fr: Arriver à voler et détruire ces <frnoun(EventItem,12,2001123,2,1)>, il nous faudrait. D'affaiblir nos ennemis, éliminer ce vecteur de l'aura nous permettrait. Cette idée, j'aimerais donc mettre en œuvre.
entries.ja:
しかしを奪い、破壊すれば、
敵に与えられる加護を弱めることができる！
ゆえにそれがし、一計を案じ申した。

entries.en: Our demented kin also draw strength from the fires of the Inferno altar. Casting wildfire idols into its flames will cause the blessings to feed one upon the other, igniting a conflagration violent enough to ensure their mutual destruction.
entries.fr: Un moyen de le détruire, il faut cependant trouver. Dans l'autel sacré de ces devins, une flamme d'Ifrit brûle. Jeter les <frnoun(EventItem,12,2001123,2,1)> dans le feu de celui-ci, nous pourrions. Détruire les objets en même temps que l'autel, l'énergie dégagée pourrait peut-être.

奴らが焔神の加護を得るために用いている祭壇。
この祭壇に「」を投げこめば、
過剰なる魔力の奔流により、双方を破壊できるやもしれぬ。

Bear the idols to the Inferno altar, and hurl them into the flames!
...Be sure to stand back from the explosion, honored ally. I would not have you perish in such a foolish manner.

entries.en: Again, the illusion of my addled kin's strength is revealed. When power is not earned, there is no control. You have proven the truth of that, honored ally.
entries.fr: Incertaine, la réussite de ce plan était. Mais de joie, ton succès me remplit. Une bonne leçon pour nos ennemis, cela sera.
entries.ja:
暗中模索ではありましたが、成功して何より。
占星術師どもも、目にものを見たに違いありませぬ！
